author: Daniel Greene
description:
Mass market paperbacks are dying. The average trade paperback now costs $21.47. A new hardback with tax can run close to $40 — nearly a full day's wages for a minimum wage worker in America. In this video I break down exactly why book prices have exploded, who benefits, and whether anything can be done about it.
Patreon: https://patreon.com/DanielBGreene
Stay Gold Books: https://www.instagram.com/staygoldbookspgh/ 


Topics covered: the death of the mass market paperback, COVID's impact on paper and shipping costs, Amazon's monopoly on physical books, ebooks and audiobooks, how Barnes & Noble and Amazon get deals independent bookstores can't access, what countries like France and Germany do differently, and what happened to the UK when they got rid of their book price protection laws.
title: BOOK PRICES ARE TOO DAMN HIGH!... But Why?
